start_here: Say to your AI: "Publish the built preview of option x05-r4-1 in /films/made-up-film into its previews folder, and put it in my watch folder only after the rendered-video check passed." It runs publish first and watch only when the check allows it.

lists.label: Settings
lists.holds: One row per tool and scope (a person, a film, a piece or the whole account): the settings that tool reads when it runs, as JSON.

instructions: 1. Pour the two example setting rows into your own settings list (see pour) and fill the film's row with preview.frame, preview.content_gate and the layout.
2. Build the preview first with tool:build-a-filmcraft-option-preview so it sits in work-round-<n>/pending/.

3. Say what you said in start_here. Your AI reads the row with tools:list and runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/publish_preview.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with action publish.
4. Run tool:check-a-rendered-video on the published file, then run the same command with action watch. If it refuses, read why and fix that; never copy the file into the watch folder another way.

worked_examples.title: A built preview is published; watch is refused until the rendered-video check ran
worked_examples.ask: Publish option x05-r4-1's preview and then put it in my watch folder.
worked_examples.given: From tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/test/test_filmcraft_preview.py (publish_moves_a_whole_preview_and_refuses_a_wrong_one, watch_needs_the_check_the_gate_and_a_watch_name), run for real on its made-up film after the build of x05-r4-1 (preview range 38.0 to 58.0). The AI runs `python3 tools/put-picked-options-into-a-filmcraft-project/do-work/publish_preview.py /films/made-up-film/request.json` with request.json = {"film":"/films/made-up-film","option":"x05-r4-1","action":"publish","settings":{...}}. A second request with "action":"watch" is the refusal shown.
worked_examples.hands_back: publish: {"result":{"published":[{"option":"x05-r4-1","preview":"/films/made-up-film/cuts/options-one/previews-round-4/x05-r4-1.mp4","duration_s":20.0}]}} and the mp4 and its jpg moved out of work-round-4/pending. watch before any check: {"error":"x05-r4-1: the rendered-video check has not been run on /films/made-up-film/cuts/options-one/previews-round-4/x05-r4-1.mp4 (expected /films/made-up-film/cuts/options-one/work-round-4/qa/x05-r4-1.json, newer than the preview)"} and the watch folder stays empty.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
